entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Mary's Church is a Roman Catholic church and co-cathedral located in central Gdańsk, Poland. Completed in 1502 in the Brick Gothic architectural style, it is one of the world's largest brick churches and among the city's most important landmarks, known to its inhabitants as the Crown of Gdańsk. Together with Oliwa Cathedral, it serves the Archdiocese of Gdańsk.
